_doc: The first slice of the economy mod (#524): the Town Center is the storehouse, the lumber and mining camps are the woodcutter's hut and the quarry, and the sawmill is new. Buildings cost planks and stone, carried to the site. Everything for war and the late game goes.

town_center.name: Storehouse
town_center.desc: Holds the town's goods; serfs carry them in and out, and wait here when there's nothing to do. Room for the whole town.

lumber_camp.name: Woodcutter's Hut
lumber_camp.desc: A woodcutter works here: fells the trees round it one at a time, a trunk each, and leaves them for the serfs. With no grown tree in reach, he plants saplings, which grow into trees.

mining_camp.name: Quarry
mining_camp.desc: A stone cutter works here: cuts the stone round it and leaves it for the carriers.

school.name: School
school.desc: Teaches the town's people: new serfs, and woodcutters, stone cutters, miners, farmers, millers, bakers, smelters, smiths, swineherds and butchers for the workplaces. Each goes to work where it's needed.

sawmill.name: Sawmill
sawmill.desc: A sawyer works here: saws one log into two planks. Nothing is sawn while the sawyer is away.

road._doc: extends the house only because a mod's new building must (mods.lobster); a road plan has no look (game/roads)
road.name: Road
road.desc: Drag to lay a road, a cell at a time. Workers walk faster on it. Each cell takes a stone, carried there, and a moment's work.

inn.name: Inn
inn.desc: Feeds the town: hungry workers eat here. One loaf or sausage makes three meals, so it feeds more for less than the storehouse does (a whole one a meal). Carriers keep it stocked with bread and sausages.

iron_smelter.name: Iron Smelter
iron_smelter.desc: A smelter works here: melts a load of iron ore with a load of coal into an iron bar. Nothing is smelted while the smelter is away.

gold_smelter.name: Gold Smelter
gold_smelter.desc: A smelter works here: melts a load of gold ore with a load of coal into five gold, what the School is paid in. Nothing is smelted while the smelter is away.

butcher.name: Butcher
butcher.desc: A butcher works here: makes a pig into three sausages. Nothing is made while the butcher is away.

farm.name: Farm
farm.desc: A farmer works here: reaps the wheat, leaves the grain for the carriers and sows the field again.

pig_farm.name: Pig Farm
pig_farm.desc: A swineherd works here: fattens a pig on two sacks of grain. Nothing is fattened while the swineherd is away.

mill.name: Mill
mill.desc: A miller works here: grinds a sack of grain into a sack of flour. Nothing is milled while the miller is away.

bakery.name: Bakery
bakery.desc: A baker works here: bakes a sack of flour into two loaves. Nothing is baked while the baker is away.

armoury.name: Smithy
armoury.desc: A smith works here: forges an iron bar and a plank into tools. The stone cutters, farmers, millers and bakers need tools to start work.

coal_mine.name: Coal Mine
coal_mine.desc: Goes up only with its back to a seam of coal in the mountain. A miner works here: digs the seam behind it and leaves the coal for the carriers. When the seam is dug out, the mine stops.

iron_mine.name: Iron Mine
iron_mine.desc: Goes up only with its back to a seam of iron ore in the mountain. A miner works here: digs the seam behind it and leaves the iron ore for the carriers. When the seam is dug out, the mine stops.

gold_mine.name: Gold Mine
gold_mine.desc: Goes up only with its back to a seam of gold ore in the mountain. A miner works here: digs the seam behind it and leaves the gold ore for the carriers. When the seam is dug out, the mine stops.
